description.narrative: (El Salvador): Futuro Hoy, also known as Future Now: Training and Employment for Youth, aims to improve educational and economic opportunities for vulnerable youth in high-migration areas of El Salvador through a comprehensive approach spanning self-empowerment, academic support, and skills training. By addressing different life stages, this activity is investing in developing various skill sets that will ensure school completion and successful transition to the labor market. It also supports teachers by enhancing digital competencies in schools, introducing technology to boost school engagement and learning outcomes.Fundacion Poma, together with a consortium of partners, has a successful track record implementing education and workforce development programs, with over 30 years of experience implementing programs supporting developmental pathways for vulnerable children and youth in El Salvador. Futuro Hoy will build upon existing programs and coordinate closely with other USAID-funded activities to provide solutions to critical problems in building hope and supporting youth to successfully move through the education-to-workforce pipeline.The activity partners with Salvadoran private sector organizations to identify demand in the labor market and offer on-the-job training, psychosocial support, and job placement for youth, including those in shelters. Through collaboration with the private sector, the activity fosters capacity building for both youth and teachers while encouraging training and job placement for likely migrants. Strategically aligned with ICS MO 3.2 and RCS Pillar I, the activity supports children and youth by closing the digital divide, improving employability, and enhancing educational success.

Mejorar la educación de la primera infancia, la educación primaria y la educación secundaria, impartidas en entornos formales o no formales. Incluye programas de alfabetización, aritmética y otras habilidades básicas para jóvenes y adultos.
